alerts.subject: URGENT: paid booking MSV-20261005-DLT2: Cloudbeds refused to record the payment
lines: Booking MSV-20261005-DLT2 (Cloudbeds reservation res_1) was PAID via Stripe (THB 28350.00, session cs_test_1), but Cloudbeds refused to record the payment: postPayment: Payment type not found

Payment method sent: "Stripe(website)", from CLOUDBEDS_STRIPE_PAYMENT_METHOD (outside live: CLOUDBEDS_STRIPE_TEST_PAYMENT_METHOD when set). It must be the exact 'method' value scripts/cloudbeds-wi0-check.mjs prints for the custom Stripe method (for HTTP 401/403, check the booking key's write:payment scope instead).

Do NOT cancel this reservation: the guest has paid. First open the folio: Stripe, the guest's return page and the sweeper keep retrying, so if a Stripe payment of THB 28350.00 is already listed, it was recorded automatically after this alert - do not add it again, only confirm the reservation if it is not Confirmed yet. Otherwise EITHER fix the value and redeploy (the sweeper then records the payment and confirms the booking) OR record the FULL amount THB 28350.00 (rooms + fee) once on the folio by hand and confirm it - never both.

If the "Payment processing fee" line is not on the folio yet, recording the full amount leaves a credit equal to that fee: this is expected while the booking is still being retried. Do NOT add the "Payment processing fee" line by hand: it is added automatically once Cloudbeds accepts it, and "the processing fee line is missing" follows if it never can.

alerts.subject: URGENT: paid booking MSV-20261005-Z8FN: Cloudbeds refused to record the payment
lines: Booking MSV-20261005-Z8FN (Cloudbeds reservation res_4) was PAID via Stripe (THB 28350.00, session cs_test_4), but Cloudbeds refused to record the payment: postPayment: Payment type not found

Payment method sent: "Stripe(website)", from CLOUDBEDS_STRIPE_PAYMENT_METHOD (outside live: CLOUDBEDS_STRIPE_TEST_PAYMENT_METHOD when set). It must be the exact 'method' value scripts/cloudbeds-wi0-check.mjs prints for the custom Stripe method (for HTTP 401/403, check the booking key's write:payment scope instead).

Do NOT cancel this reservation: the guest has paid. First open the folio: Stripe, the guest's return page and the sweeper keep retrying, so if a Stripe payment of THB 28350.00 is already listed, it was recorded automatically after this alert - do not add it again, only confirm the reservation if it is not Confirmed yet. Otherwise EITHER fix the value and redeploy (the sweeper then records the payment and confirms the booking) OR record the FULL amount THB 28350.00 (rooms + fee) once on the folio by hand and confirm it - never both.

If the "Payment processing fee" line is not on the folio yet, recording the full amount leaves a credit equal to that fee: this is expected while the booking is still being retried. Do NOT add the "Payment processing fee" line by hand: it is added automatically once Cloudbeds accepts it, and "the processing fee line is missing" follows if it never can.
